key_insight: In simulated worlds with altered physics, the evaluated LLMs rarely discovered hidden laws through free exploration without research tasks or hints.
engineering_relevance: LongChang provides an automated testbed for evaluating whether AI agents can notice anomalies, design experiments, and infer unfamiliar physical rules.
method: Create simulated scenes where one or more physical laws differ from ordinary physics.
Let LLM explorers manipulate objects, build tools, and investigate self-generated questions.
Use separate LLM agents to review scenes and tools, evaluate reports, and guide scene evolution.
evidence_signal: Across 12 evaluated LLMs, GPT-6-Astra achieved a 16.7% discovery rate and the other 11 scored 0%; exploration records showed uninvestigated anomalies and partial law identification.
watch_item: Results come from simulated worlds and LLM-assisted evaluation, so real-world scientific discovery performance remains unestablished.
paper_title: Can LLMs Uncover Hidden Physical Laws through Free Exploration?
